description: Evidence registry for the eleven fail-closed MED+250 production launch gates. A gate may be confirmed only after its referenced evidence exists and has a named approver and timezone-qualified approval timestamp.

MED250_GATE_GPS_READY.title: Authoritative pharmacy GPS readiness
MED250_GATE_GPS_READY.acceptance: The approved operating pharmacy set has authoritative premises coordinates with reviewer identity and durable source evidence, and strict operational health reports dispatch-ready coverage.

evidence.summary: Privacy-safe production health snapshot confirming governed GPS and dispatch-ready coverage with no strict health findings.

MED250_GATE_WHATSAPP_READY.title: Pharmacy WhatsApp readiness
MED250_GATE_WHATSAPP_READY.acceptance: The approved operating pharmacy set has current, pharmacy-authorised login-enabled WhatsApp contacts and the strict operational-health check passes.

evidence.summary: Privacy-safe production health snapshot confirming governed WhatsApp login coverage and no recent delivery failures.

MED250_GATE_DUPLICATE_REGISTER_REVIEWED.title: Duplicate-register review
MED250_GATE_DUPLICATE_REGISTER_REVIEWED.acceptance: The strict duplicate-register verifier passes with named, timestamped decisions for every synchronized product and pharmacy duplicate group.

MED250_GATE_SECURITY_HARDENING_DEPLOYED.title: Security-hardening migration deployment
MED250_GATE_SECURITY_HARDENING_DEPLOYED.acceptance: The 2026-07-23.1 marketplace hardening migration is deployed first to controlled staging and then to production using approved credentials. Negative authorization, locking, public-description privilege, media-hold, rollback, aggregate backend-contract, and operational-health checks pass for the exact immutable application release.

MED250_GATE_EDGE_FUNCTIONS_DEPLOYED.title: Revised Edge Function deployment
MED250_GATE_EDGE_FUNCTIONS_DEPLOYED.acceptance: The revised dawanear-pharmacy-verify-otp function bound to the 2026-07-23.1 reviewed phone-to-tenant RPC is deployed first to controlled staging and then to production. Created-user cleanup, duplicate-phone rejection, revoked and suspended authority, cross-tenant isolation, concurrency locking, origin validation, and the protected boundaries of all other production Edge Functions pass for the exact immutable release.

MED250_GATE_TURNSTILE_SERVER_VERIFIED.title: Turnstile server verification
MED250_GATE_TURNSTILE_SERVER_VERIFIED.acceptance: Supabase Auth validates production Turnstile tokens and controlled tests prove invalid or missing tokens cannot create new customer identities.

MED250_GATE_AUTH_RATE_LIMITS_APPROVED.title: Anonymous-auth rate-limit approval
MED250_GATE_AUTH_RATE_LIMITS_APPROVED.acceptance: Project-wide anonymous-auth limits are approved after impact review and controlled tests prove intended customers can order without weakening abuse controls.

MED250_GATE_PRESCRIPTION_RETENTION_APPRO.title: Prescription-retention approval
MED250_GATE_PRESCRIPTION_RETENTION_APPRO.acceptance: The privacy owner approves the implemented retention periods and cleanup schedule, and a controlled cleanup run produces a healthy, non-stale aggregate signal.

evidence.summary: Protected production retention cleanup completed successfully and a fresh aggregate privacy-safe health check confirmed the signal remains current.

MED250_GATE_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_VERIFIED.title: Cloudflare account verification
MED250_GATE_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_VERIFIED.acceptance: The intended Cloudflare account, least-privilege deploy token, Worker names, protected environments and route ownership are verified with a redacted account record.

MED250_GATE_DOMAIN_DNS_VERIFIED.title: Production domain and DNS verification
MED250_GATE_DOMAIN_DNS_VERIFIED.acceptance: med-250.com resolves through the intended Cloudflare account, TLS is healthy, the Worker custom-domain route is attached and the deployment verifier passes in live mode against the exact approved release revision.

evidence.summary: Current canonical-domain DNS, HTTPS, ten-route, security-header, robots, sitemap, manifest, service-worker, offline page, and exact-revision checks passed.
Current exact-revision production route verification passed all ten canonical live routes with no verifier errors.

MED250_GATE_PHYSICAL_UAT_PASSED.title: Controlled physical-device UAT
MED250_GATE_PHYSICAL_UAT_PASSED.acceptance: Named test identities pass GPS consent, WhatsApp OTP, dispatch, realtime confirmation, selection, WhatsApp, MoMo, expiry, cancellation and prescription-access scenarios without contacting unintended pharmacies.
